title: First-run diagnostic overlays for throttles and latency in quickstart
creator: Amelia Park
description: Create a suite of first-run diagnostic overlay assets and annotated screenshots for the Quickstart flow that surface actionable troubleshooting for rate limits, timeouts, and retry behavior. These overlays should appear contextually during the onboarding demo (first successful or failed API call) and provide a clear next step: retry, switch model tier, open dedicated capacity request, or copy diagnostics. Goal: reduce support ops tickets by surfacing targeted remediation and capture structured telemetry for follow-up.
updates: 2025-03-18: Kickoff meeting with PM and Eng. Agreed overlay appears after the first failed or degraded request during quickstart. Decided to prioritize rate-limit and timeout states for v1.

2025-03-19: Initial sketches completed. Explored three visual metaphors: compact banner, modal diagnostic card, and inline callout. Team favored a compact bottom-sheet overlay for non-blocking guidance.
2025-03-20: Figma mockups v0.1 uploaded. Added microcopy variants for retry policies and quick remediation buttons. Noted integration work for diagnostic log export (ENG-5312).

2025-03-22: Design critique done. Iterated on contrast and motion: prefer gentle bounce for attention, no long auto-dismiss. Assigned handoff tasks to ENG and PM for telemetry keys and feature flag gating.
design_decisions: Use a small bottom-sheet overlay anchored to the quickstart console to avoid interrupting learning flow.
Primary CTA shows contextual remediation (Retry / Increase tier / Request Dedicated). Secondary CTA copies diagnostic bundle.
Visual metaphor: ‘signal meter’ (three bars + color gradient) to represent throttling severity instead of traffic-light icons used elsewhere, to reduce visual redundancy.
Animations limited to subtle entrance (translateY + fade). No looping animations to respect battery and accessibility.
Localization: microcopy kept to 2 lines max; placeholders included for translations up to 120 characters.
Accessibility: overlays must be keyboard focusable, with ARIA role="alertdialog" for urgent states and descriptive alt text for SVGs.
Telemetry: overlay impressions, CTA clicks, and diagnostic bundle downloads tracked under event keys: onboarding.overlay.show, onboarding.overlay.action, onboarding.overlay.download.
Fallback strategy: if feature flag disabled, fall back to inline help link and non-interactive hint bar used in current quickstart.
Trade-offs: chose bottom-sheet to keep quickstart screenshot fidelity; cards were more flexible but more development effort to animate responsively across widths.
assets_requested: Overlay component spec (Figma frames): compact, expanded, and collapsed states
High-fidelity SVGs: signal-meter (3 states), timeout-hourglass, retry-loop icon
PNG export at 1x and 2x for docs screenshots
Motion specs: entrance 220ms ease-out, exit 180ms ease-in, no loop
Copy pack: 6 microcopy variants per state (rate-limit, timeout, retry-success, retry-failed, switch-tier, contact-support)
Localization strings CSV (en, fr, de, ja)
microcopy_examples: Rate limit (soft): We’re seeing higher-than-usual requests. Try Retry or switch to a higher-throughput tier.
Rate limit (hard): You’ve hit the rate limit. Requests will resume in ~%s seconds. Request more capacity or reduce batch size.
Timeout: The model didn’t respond in time. Try Retry (shorter input) or enable background generation for longer responses.
Retry flow success: Request succeeded on retry. Consider enabling automatic retries in Console settings.
Diagnostic bundle CTA: Copy diagnostics (includes request id, model variant, region, timestamp)
handoff_tasks: ENG: Implement onboarding.overlay feature flag (flag: onboarding_overlay_v1)
ENG: Expose telemetry events onboarding.overlay.show, onboarding.overlay.action, onboarding.overlay.download
ENG: Add API hook to produce diagnostic bundle JSON when CTA clicked (refer ENG-5312 spec)
PM: Add acceptance criteria and QA scenarios to the onboarding epic
Design: Finalize Figma components and export tokens for spacing, color, and motion
Security: Confirm diagnostic bundle excludes PII and redact keys per compliance checklist
qa_checklist: Overlay appears after a failed quickstart API call and when a degraded response occurs
CTA actions perform expected actions (retry triggers new request, copy copies bundle, switch-tier opens pricing modal)
Telemetry events fired with correct payloads and request id
Keyboard navigation focuses overlay and Esc closes overlay but does not lose progress
Localization applied for sample Spanish and Japanese strings (spot check)
Contrast ratios for icons and text meet AA standards
Diagnostic bundle contains keys: request_id, model, region, attempt_count and no secrets
feedback_notes: PM: prefer explicit 'Request Dedicated' CTA only when user is Enterprise-eligible; otherwise hide.
Eng: suggested reducing asset variants to speed front-end delivery; agreed to ship compact + expanded only.
Accessibility: confirm aria-live behavior for transient informational states vs error states.
Security: ensure KMS-managed keys are not included in diagnostic bundle.
